command:
set -eu
if ! id clusterops >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash clusterops
fi
sudo passwd -l clusterops >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sudo install -d -o clusterops -g clusterops -m 700 /home/clusterops/.ssh
if [ ! -s /home/clusterops/.ssh/id_ed25519 ]; then
  sudo -u clusterops -- ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -f /home/clusterops/.ssh/id_ed25519 -C "clusterops@$NODE_NAME"
fi
sudo chown -R clusterops:clusterops /home/clusterops/.ssh
sudo chmod 700 /home/clusterops/.ssh
sudo chmod 600 /home/clusterops/.ssh/id_ed25519
sudo chmod 644 /home/clusterops/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
hosts_tmp=$(mktemp)
awk '{ drop=0; for (i=2; i<=NF; i++) if ($i == "node1" || $i == "node2" || $i == "node3") drop=1; if (!drop) print }' /etc/hosts > "$hosts_tmp"
printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" >> "$hosts_tmp"
sudo install -o root -g root -m 644 "$hosts_tmp" /etc/hosts
rm -f "$hosts_tmp"
allow_users=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk 'BEGIN { sep="" } { printf "%sclusterops@%s", sep, $1; sep=" " }')
sudo install -d -m 755 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
printf '%s\n' 'PubkeyAuthentication yes' 'PasswordAuthentication no' 'KbdInteractiveAuthentication no' 'ChallengeResponseAuthentication no' 'PermitRootLogin no' 'PermitEmptyPasswords no' "AllowUsers $allow_users" | sudo tee /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-ssh-cluster.conf >/dev/null
sudo sshd -t
sudo systemctl enable --now ssh
sudo systemctl is-active --quiet ssh
printf '%s\n' "configured $NODE_NAME"

command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- identity and service ---'
id clusterops
passwd -S clusterops 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1, $2}'
systemctl is-enabled ssh
systemctl is-active ssh
printf '%s\n' '--- effective SSH policy ---'
sudo sshd -T | awk '$1 == "allowusers" || $1 == "pubkeyauthentication" || $1 == "passwordauthentication" || $1 == "kbdinteractiveauthentication" || $1 == "permitrootlogin" || $1 == "permitemptypasswords" {print}'
printf '%s\n' '--- peer names ---'
getent hosts node1 node2 node3
printf '%s\n' '--- clusterops SSH files ---'
sudo stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /home/clusterops/.ssh /home/clusterops/.ssh/id_ed25519 /home/clusterops/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub /home/clusterops/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/clusterops/.ssh/config /home/clusterops/.ssh/known_hosts
printf '%s\n' '--- authorized key restrictions ---'
sudo awk '{print $1}' /home/clusterops/.ssh/authorized_keys
printf '%s\n' '--- operations document ---'
sudo stat -c '%U:%G %a %s %n' /usr/local/share/doc/ssh-cluster/OPERATIONS.md
sudo sha256sum /usr/local/share/doc/ssh-cluster/OPERATIONS.md
sudo grep -E '^(# SSH cluster operations|## Topology|## Verify all six connections|## Confirm reboot persistence|## Recover from an interrupted SSH service)$' /usr/local/share/doc/ssh-cluster/OPERATIONS.md
